To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

behavioral intention has a significantly positive effect on the choice to buy energy saving appliances; environmental attitude, concern and psychological benefits have significant positive effects on behavioral intention; and that age and household size have significantly positive impacts on the choice to use energy saving appliances.

behavioral intention is a significant predictor of the choice to purchase an energy saving appliance, environmental attitude and concern, along with perceived psychological benefits, are all significant determinants of behavioral intention to purchase energy saving devices, and age and household size are both significantly and positively correlated with the choice to purchase such appliances.

environmental attitude, concern and perceived psychological benefits are significant predictors of the behavioral intention to purchase energy saving devices, while the behavioral intention to buy is a significant determinant of the actual choice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of environmental attitudes and concerns, as well as perceived benefits in shaping behavioral intention and ultimately the decision to purchase energy saving devices.
the role of environmental attitudes, concern, and psychological benefits in the purchase of energy saving devices in China.
the relationship between environmental attitude and concern and pro-environmental behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

environmental attitude, concern and psychological benefits, as well as age and household size, have significant positive effects on the decision to purchase energy saving devices among Chinese households.

the results from this study provide evidence for the effectiveness of using environmental attitude and environmental concern as well as psychological factors to promote pro-environmental behavior in China.

the choice to purchase an energy saving appliance is positively influenced by behavioral intention, which in turn is positively influenced by environmental attitude and environmental concern as well as psychological benefit perceptions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
environmental attitude and concern are the most important factors influencing behavioral intention to buy an energy saving appliance.
environmental attitude, concern and perceived psychological benefits are important predictors of the intention to purchase energy saving devices in China.
psychological benefits and environmental concern are the two most important predictors of pro environment intention in the Chinese context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice to purchase an energy saving appliance is driven by a combination of environmental attitude and concern and psychological benefits.
psychological benefits are an important driver of pro environmental behavior in developing countries.
the Chinese consumer is ready to purchase energy saving devices, but the government must provide more support to help Chinese households overcome the barriers to purchasing energy saving appliances.
